rules.rule_name: Single-Column Layout and Clean Document Architecture
rules.explanation: Multi-column layouts, text boxes, and complex tables confuse ATS parsers, causing text to be scrambled, skipped, or read out of chronological order.
rules.do: Design resumes using a clean, single-column linear layout with standard section headings (Education, Experience, Skills) and clear visual hierarchy.
rules.dont: Do not use multi-column sidebars, floating text boxes, multi-level tables, or complex graphic side panels.

rules.rule_name: Standard Font Families and Text-Based Formatting
rules.explanation: Using custom decorative fonts, embedded symbols, or rasterized text images prevents optical character recognition and automated text extraction.
rules.do: Use standard, web-safe, ATS-friendly system fonts (e.g., Arial, Calibri, Helvetica, Times New Roman) in standard sizes (10-12pt) with real selectable text.
rules.dont: Do not use non-standard decorative typography, icon graphics in place of bullet points, or convert text sections into image files.

rules.rule_name: Standard Section Headings and Semantic Ordering
rules.explanation: Non-standard or creative section titles (e.g., 'My Journey', 'What I Do') prevent ATS parsers from correctly categorizing candidate data.
rules.do: Use industry-standard section headings ('Professional Summary', 'Work Experience', 'Education', 'Technical Skills') recognized universally by parsing algorithms.
rules.dont: Do not use obscure, cryptic, or overly creative headers that fail standard categorization dictionaries.

rules.rule_name: File Format Compatibility and Clean Extension Standards
rules.explanation: Submitting resumes in image-heavy formats or non-standard file extensions can result in complete rejection or unreadable binary garbage during upload.
rules.do: Export and submit resumes strictly in clean text-layer PDF format or standard Microsoft Word (.docx) documents as requested by the portal.
rules.dont: Do not upload image-based PDFs, password-protected files, or obscure file extensions that lack raw text streams.
